note: Evidence level is assigned per claim. Mechanism Certified is never promoted to Product-level Evidence. Decision and Constraint are non-measurement classes.

claims.claim: On the RC1.3 retrieval probe, economy with semanticMode none matched Basic's measured quality (3.00/3) after the retrieval-ergonomics fix.
claims.harness: RC1.3 retrieval probe, one window, n=9 per arm
claims.configuration: economy; semanticMode none; retrieval hint in the framing section
claims.datasetVersion: one probe: three facts in one message
claims.resultSummary: un-hinted 2.33/3 -> 3.00/3 (run A), 3.00/3 (run B); hinted unchanged; economy-none matches Basic on this probe.
claims.limitations: n small, one probe shape, one route. The 2.33 -> 3.00 step rests on 2 of 9 runs. Model/route not recorded in the document.
claims.status: current for the zero-LLM config; NOT transferable to today's economy tier, which makes one rationale call per fold

claims.claim: On the n=5 RC1.2 sample, economy-none cost about 0.00166 per run against Basic's 0.02778, roughly 17x cheaper at equal measured quality.
claims.configuration: economy; semanticMode none; no auxiliary calls
claims.resultSummary: 0.00166 vs 0.02778 per run; cost gate remains OPEN.
claims.limitations: n=5, one route, one price list, no cache-separation analysis recorded. Does not include a rationale call, so it does not describe today's economy tier.
claims.status: current for the zero-LLM config only

claims.claim: A fold writes its CheckpointBundle before the lossy surface replacement commits; an archive failure aborts the transaction.
claims.resultSummary: the publish path writes the bundle before returning the summary to Basic.
claims.limitations: A test suite proves the code path, not a production crash-consistency rate.

claims.claim: R33's live evaluation was not executed: no budget permission and no resolved route; 0 provider requests.
claims.resultSummary: exit 3, not-executed; 17/17 scripted self-test proves plumbing only.
claims.limitations: No behavioral claim is available from R33. The generated eval/r33/out/live-report.json is rewritten by the test suite, so the committed document is the stable artifact.

claims.claim: R34 has no real-model result; its 68/68 four-arm self-test is a plumbing result.
claims.resultSummary: 0 provider requests; 68/68 valid and task success under a scripted adapter.

claims.claim: The real writer extracted facts, but the automatic exact scorer reported 0 recall because the model paraphrased and used its own coordinates.
claims.resultSummary: 16 scored outputs; automatic recall 0; manual adjudication found the facts were present but paraphrased.
claims.limitations: Scorer-coordinate mismatch, not a writer coverage result. One model/route.
claims.status: superseded as a recall measurement by the R36/R37 scorer corrections

claims.claim: R36 ran 845 provider requests and aligned the W1 writer contract with the validator; the B1/S comparison is exploratory.
claims.resultSummary: 12 writer + 833 continuation requests; W1 is the better writer contract.
claims.limitations: Exploratory; one model/route; harness floor documented separately.
claims.status: current as an interface result, not as a product benefit

claims.claim: Under the R37-B Stage 2 conditions, the Active arm showed a negative contract difference: 9 damage vs 1 rescue over 36 pairs.
claims.datasetVersion: A1-v2, D1-v2, B2, C1, F1, H1; 6 replicates
claims.scorerVersion: R37-B scorer (version not recorded as a single field)
claims.resultSummary: 36 pairs: contract rescue 1, damage 9, both 17, neither 9; task rescue 2, damage 7, both 20, neither 7.
claims.limitations: Custom harness; B1 is NOT Native DSH Basic; protocol confounds; case-clustered; one model/route; Stage 1 not pooled.
claims.status: current: Active not supported under these conditions; a harm signal, not a population estimate

claims.claim: The semantic funnel metric overstated commit/recall; the corrected measurement separates pipeline, writer and scorer effects.
claims.resultSummary: the correction is recorded; earlier recall numbers are not reused.
claims.limitations: A measurement correction, not a new behavioral result.
claims.status: current; supersedes the earlier funnel numbers

claims.claim: R37-C gate C1-D (Stage 1 admission) is gate-not-verifiable; Stage 1 cannot be used as a confirmatory batch.
claims.limitations: Historical; not repaired by a new threshold.

claims.claim: The 24-cell process pilot completed with 17/24 legacy contract, 17/24 operational completion and 8/24 strict finish; the process sentence helps D1 and hurts B2.
claims.route: Unknown (not recorded in the pilot artifact)
claims.configuration: B1/S x P0/P1; finish guard off; step budget 8
claims.resultSummary: 24/24 cells; legacy 17; operational 17; strict finish 8; B2 P0 5/6 -> P1 3/6; D1 P0 3/6 -> P1 6/6.
claims.limitations: Exploratory; 3 replicates; one model; two cases; route not recorded; the process prompt is not a uniform fix.

claims.claim: A tool-grounded finding cannot retire a user constraint: the claim is accepted and the retirement is refused with insufficient-authority.
claims.resultSummary: 8/8 scenarios; pre-fix reproduction retired the constraint; post-fix it stays active.
claims.limitations: Mechanism only; no live writer. The decision authority domain still does not distinguish a user decision from an assistant decision.

claims.claim: Claim identity is separate from revision identity: the same claim with a new supersession plan has the same deltaId and can contribute its operations; an exact repeat is refused.
claims.resultSummary: 7/7; replay once matches; a double application is detected by the commit-state digest.
claims.limitations: The reducer is idempotent for declares; the once-only boundary is the commit digest, not the reducer.

claims.claim: N5 is reproducible and detected: an incomplete revision leaves the rejected outbox active and the auditor reports stale-negative-knowledge; a complete revision clears it.
claims.resultSummary: 9/9; the incomplete case is requires-review, the complete case is clean.
claims.limitations: A lexical candidate, not a truth verdict; nothing is auto-retired.

claims.claim: Task-aware selection improves critical-fact coverage under budget pressure and fixes the prefix selector's break defect.
claims.resultSummary: 5/5; B2 critical 0/1 -> 1/1; scope tokens 122 -> 76; greedy skip keeps C.
claims.limitations: Fixtures only; eval code, not a production default; no model behavior.
claims.status: Mechanism Certified, not a product candidate

claims.claim: Bounded archive recovery recovers facts that never entered active state, with honest coverage statuses.
claims.resultSummary: 8/8; 2/5 fixtures recovered archive-only; a genuine miss and a descriptor-bound miss get different statuses.
claims.limitations: Synthetic bundles; no engine-level recovery test; no gold leakage but also no live query.
claims.status: Mechanism Certified, not a product candidate

claims.claim: The context overlay is delivered through the real DSH runtime-context channel with stable digests; the journal and checkpoint are not modified.
claims.resultSummary: 6/6; identical steps produce one snapshot; a JSONL resume delivers the same digest; journalModified false.
claims.limitations: Scripted adapter; proves the delivery path, not model behavior.
claims.status: Mechanism Certified, not a product candidate

claims.claim: EF Active remains on deployment hold; no product-level benefit has been demonstrated.
claims.resultSummary: deployment-hold; deploymentEligible false; R38 made 0 live calls.
claims.limitations: A decision, not a measurement. It is revisited only with new behavioral evidence.
